_comment: Directory data for the Nepali mirror. Applies to every .md file in src/ne/,
so a translated page cannot forget to declare which language it is in — and
the layout therefore cannot be tricked into printing an English footer
Each page still carries its own translationOf, sourceHash and
translationState. Those are per-page facts and must not be defaulted here:
a missing sourceHash has to read as stale, which is what
